documents.title: Careers at Shiretechnik
documents.content: Shiretechnik is a multidisciplinary engineering team delivering innovative CFD, marine, thermal, and industrial engineering solutions for clients across the globe. Open domains include Maritime Engineering, Turbomachinery, HVAC & Fire Safety, and Electronic Cooling. Applications are submitted through the careers page. For current openings and to apply, visit the careers page or complete the application form.

documents.title: Maritime Engineering
documents.content: Overview: Maritime Engineering at Shiretechnik involves advanced CFD simulations, hydrodynamic optimization, naval architecture, and ship performance analysis for global marine projects. Key areas include CFD, hydrodynamics, hull optimization, and naval architecture. Apply below to join the team.

documents.title: Turbomachinery
documents.content: Overview: Turbomachinery at Shiretechnik involves design and optimization of pumps, compressors, turbines, fans, and rotating machinery using advanced engineering simulation tools. Key areas include pumps, compressors, turbines, and rotating equipment. Apply below to join the team.

documents.title: HVAC & Fire Safety
documents.content: Overview: HVAC & Fire Safety at Shiretechnik involves developing HVAC airflow solutions, smoke management studies, thermal simulations, and fire safety engineering systems. Key areas include HVAC, fire safety, thermal analysis, and smoke simulation. Apply below to join the team.

documents.title: Electronic Cooling
documents.content: Overview: Electronic Cooling at Shiretechnik involves engineering advanced thermal management solutions for electronics, batteries, and high-performance systems. Key areas include battery cooling, electronics cooling, heat transfer, and thermal management. Apply below to join the team.

documents.title: Application Process
documents.content: To apply for a role at Shiretechnik, complete the application form on the careers page. Our recruitment team will carefully review your application and contact shortlisted candidates. We are always looking for talented engineers and simulation specialists passionate about solving complex real-world engineering challenges. Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.
